Beautifully perfumed with lime, pear, white flowers and notes of fresh herbs. Its subtle acidity along with a hint of saltiness, makes the wine fresh, precise and tasty.

Located in the heart of the Mâcon wine region, Domaine de Rochebin is situated at an altitude of 450 m, on a hilltop overlooking the Saône plain, close to Azé. This village is known for its prehistoric caves. The domaine was created in 1921, but was only dedicated exclusively to viticulture from 1972. The estate is managed according to the principles of sustainable viticulture. Made from 100% Chardonnay, the wine is yellow-gold hued with green tints. Flowers (acacia, honeysuckle) and citrus (grapefruit, mandarin) appear on the nose. Smooth and fresh on the palate with an elegant finish.
A crisp, balanced, Sauvignon blanc showing an abundance of tropical fruit, gooseberry, zesty citrus, hints of minerality and juicey lime acidity. Enjoy alongside seafood dishes.
An exceptional fermentation with a mineral style which wonderfully accompanies Ossetra caviar or fi ne marinated sashimi or grilled fi sh.

The fruit for this wine was grown at the Hill Smith Vineyard at Woodside in the Adelaide Hills. The vines at this east-facing vineyard grow in alluvial loam, limestone, shale and quartz, at an altitude of around 400m. Thanks to near-perfect weather, 2021 promises to be one of the best Adelaide Hills vintages in recent memory.

Created in the 1990’s as part of the evolving Penfolds white wine development program, Bin 51 captures many attributes of the Eden Valley locale. The region’s high altitude and cool climate induces riesling with great finesse and elegance with a capacity for long-term cellaring. South Australia has gained worldwide recognition for producing definitive world-class riesling and Eden Valley always features. In their youth, the wines possess scented floral and citrus aromas, with a mineral edge and marked natural acidity, contributing significantly to the palate texture and flavour.

The 22 degree Halo is a 'stepping stone' wine, brining together grape varieties that originate from cooler regions of Europe with climate-adaptive grape varieties such as Lambrusco and Montepulciano, which have forged a reputation of making great red wines in Australia's warm and dry climate. The vision of this wine is to introduce 'YOU' to climate adaptive grape varieties through the blend of grape varieties.

Our goal is simple: to have a positive impact on the planet. With our lightweight bottle and climate positive programme, Round Theory is consciously crafted to do good and taste great. Piquette is a naturally lower in alcohol fruit wine; sustainably crafted by upcycling pressed grape skins. Our Piquette from Sauvignon Blanc is light, crisp and refreshing, with vibrant gooseberry complemented by tropical and zesty citrus flavours.

Wild Folk - delicious, naturally!  A range of natural, easy drinking wines that offer great value and consistency.  Wild Folk are wild yeast fermented, vegan friendly, preservative free wines that have no additions & taste as nature intended.

This Squealing Pig Pink Moscato is our sweetest wine yet. Blush pink in colour with bright aromatics of lifted rose petal and Turkish Delight. The palate is bursting with flavours of rose water, raspberries and musk and finishes with a sweetness that is balanced by acidity, best enjoyed whilst young and vibrant.

Australia’s fastest growing Preservative Free wine range, The Hero wines are made without compromise. Hand crafted from the best quality fruit sourced from premium vineyards and bottled without any added sulphur.  Choose your Hero and say no to 220! Vegan Friendly & Preservative Free!

The Lindeman’s Early Harvest wines are 25% lighter in alcohol and calories*, enabling you to enjoy great tasting wine as part of a lighter lifestyle. It’s the combination of Lindeman’s winemaking heritage and the skills and innovation of the winemaking team that allows Lindeman’s to create wines that are thoroughly enjoyable and lighter in alcohol and calories.
This Riesling has ripe flavours of lemon and delicate florals, balanced with clean, refreshing acidity.

The Brookland Valley Chardonnay is full of intense fruit aromas and a balanced palate. the bouquet displays lifted peach and nectarine notes combined with cashew, nougat and brioche. the palate is generous with citrus and stone fruit dominance. these flavours are supported by vanilla, spice and toasty oak.

The Brookland Valley Discovery Pinot Grigio hails from the Swan District in WA. This wine has an aromatic bouquet of pear, apple and mandarin with honey and rose nuance. the palate is textural displaying guava, melon, lychee and citrus notes.

Simply named from our address at Coldstream, the 864 range is a showcase of highly detailed micro-selections from the most exceptional single vineyard sites in the Yarra Valley. Pale straw with light green hues. An intense and complex opening with aromas of white flowers, nectarine, green apple and grapefruit but also complexity derived from solid fermentation in barrel with flint, burnt matches and just a hint of vanilla pod from the 20% new French puncheons. The palate is powerful and muscular but clearly defined. The stone fruit characters are joined with lemon and lime citrus characters which drive the acidity and elongate the wine giving incredible persistence of flavour.

Pale straw in appearance with a green hue.
Alluringl y complex aroma with powerful yet restrained intensity . Burnt match and gunflint sits over grapefruit, lemon, white flowers and green skinned nectarine, hints of fresh cashew and toast just hover in the background.
Unfolding with every look.
The palate is pure and intricately detailed, with a great depth of fruit that builds in intensity as it travels across the mid-palate. Flint and slate, lead to nectarine, pomelo and grilled citrus. Seamlessly textured and creamy yeast notes form body and flesh. The finish is persistent, long and precise with savoury phenolics and mineral refreshment. Linear, formed and complex.
Sourced from Funder & Diamond Vineyard, Drive Block, this genre-leading Chardonnay is widely regarded as one of Australia’s great chardonnays, and a worthy match to premier or even grand cru Burgundy.
864 Single Block Release
864 are exceptional wines from specific and single blocks within a vineyard selected for their age and maturity. With these wines we would like you to appreciate and explore the sensation in a bottle from place or the specific terroir within a vineyard.

Very fine persistent bead. Straw coloured and vibrant, fresh hue. Fruit aromas of pear flesh and grilled grapefruit intermingle with brioches and freshly baked sourdough. Light toasty elements and slight yoghurt notes add complexity and depth. The palate is creamy and textural with delicate web of acidity interwoven throughout. Cream, yeast, granny smooth apples and butter pastry flavours flow along before finishing with a preserved lemon-like tang.

Murdoch Hill Sauvignon Blanc - A vibrant and bright pale white wine with notes of aromatic stone and tropical fruits on the nose. This Sauvignon Blanc carries the signature characteristics of the Adelaide Hills style with a clean and crisp palate of gooseberries and citrus fruits, followed by delicate acidity and a complementing mineral finish.

The South Island of New Zealand is home to Marlborough - widely recognsed as one of the worlds greatest cool climate wine-producing areas. Long, sun-filled growing seasons and cool nights combine to produce the vibrant fruit flavours for which Marlborough is famous. This 'white mist' Pinot Gris is lower in alcohol* and full of crisp pear and apple flavours. This wine is light and fresh with good length and a balanced finish.
*At least 25% lighter in alcohol than the average New Zealand Pinot Gris.
Fresh aromas of passionfruit and lemon citrus. Passionfruit and lemon citrus and are displayed through the palate. balanced by a crisp refreshing acidity on the finish.

Isabel Estate remains true to its roots by creating sustainable, exceptional wines that are 100% estate-grown, estate-made and estate-bottled in Marlborough New Zealand. This Sauvignon Blanc ascends with aromatics of tropical fruit, grapefruit and gooseberry, balanced by structural minerality and creamy finish. Conveniently bottled in a 375mL bottle.

Neon Nature is a growing taste sensation made for natural enthusiasts with wild hearts, The Pet Nat is as bright as the name suggests with a radiance fit for curious minds and discorning tastes. Neon Nature Pet Nat Sauvignon provides an insight into what the winemaker tastes when tasting ferments & wine still in their raw state. Bottled before fermentation has finished, capturing CO2 and remaining cloudy A bright & fun fruit driven sparkling wine showning notes of lychees, passionfruit, peach & guava.The palate is lively with crsip acidity & bubbles that dance along your tongue.

Ghost Town Chardonnay is handcrafted in very limited quantities. Generous aromas of peach, naval orange and meyerlemons with acacia blossom and a touch of brioche in the background lead to a creamy, and textural palate. Integrated nougat oak, with subtle spice and hints of flint are showcased on the palate. A fine, precise acidity flows through the wine to a persistent finish.
Freya’s Once & Well wines are grown in ancient granite-based soils. They are wines of place, expressing the essence of Margaret River, with fruit sourced from a few different sites.

Once & Well’s Chardonnay comes from grapes grown in both the warmer and cooler areas of the Margaret River region, mixing tropical and citrus characteristics to produce a distinctive and well-balanced wine. The Chardonnay’s nose is vibrant, rich and enticing with tropical fruits such as lychee and pineapple, citrus, some spice, nougat and hints of jasmine. The palate is light and refreshing with a mealy mid-palate and elegant finish. A touch of vanilla and spicy oak gives this Chardonnay a refined note.

Most well-known and typical Austrian quality wine. Classic Grüner Veltliner from loess-soil, greenish yellow, spicy and zesty with the typical peppery note, dry and fruity.
Goes well with typical Austrian dishes like “Wiener Schnitzel”, roasted chicken etc. A lot of cheese varieties, fish dishes and Italian food as Pizzas and Pasta harmonize with this great wine.

Winemakers Selection Vat 1 Semillon only ever comes from our best old vine, dry grown vineyards. These blocks feature ideal sandy, free draining soils that give these wines their unique character. The oldest of these blocks was planted in 1923.

product_name: Winemakers The Maker Margaret River Chardonnay
product_description: The underlying patterns of the ancient trees of Western Australia reflect wine legend John Tate's legacy - a living history of the region that he helped make. The Maker Chardonnay shows lifted aromas of grapefruit, stonefruit and hints of oak spice. With delicious flavours of ripe white peach, fresh citrus and an elegant finish. Beautifully served alongside roast chicken.

product_name: Winemakers The Maker Margaret River Semillon Sauvignon Blanc
product_description: The John Tate name is synonymous with the Margaret River, legendary for his innovative spirit. He, along with his much loved community, developed the region as a beacon for premium winemaking recognised for a quality all around the world. This Semillon Sauvignon Blanc is a perfect representation of the rhythm of Western Australia with a combination of crisp clean white, sunshine and the whispering of the wind through the vines to create Torch Song. This vibrant wine has citrus and floral notes, with a subtle grassy taste and clean finish. Delicious with a light seafood meal.

Intense, harmonious and complex with noticeable citrus, apricot, linden and white flowers scents. Full, intense and of great balance. In its complexity you can appreciate scents of cherry, apple and mango. Pair with poultry, fish, and soft cheeses.

This Chardonnay has been made from a small single clone block grown in the Robinson Vineyard at Tuerong. A beautiful chardonnay with great aromatics of citrus, white flower and sulphides. An interesting contrast to our Paringa Estate chardonnays from Red Hill vineyards. We have called this wine the Robinson Vineyard to officially recognize where the fruit has come from and to pay my respects to Hugh's efforts for growing such great quality fruit. 2021 is the first release of this wine.

This amazing Riesling is a blend of the Pewsey Vale and Eden Valley regions giving it lovely notes of citrus peel, lime and spice, lychees, apple flavor and on the palate a beautiful clear varietal expression and lively acidity. Mouthfilling, poised, elegant. Soft minerality. Fine silky finish.

Proudly Australian, Sit Stay Society celebrates our best companions who are always by our side, dogs. Inspired by their mighty character, 'Big Dog' is a range of wines that honour our larger canine companions. Cleo’s Chardonnay has tantalising aromas of jasmine, peach and lemon blossom with underlying toasted oak. Citrus and stone fruit flavours provide a crisp mineral-like finish. The perfect match with soft camembert cheese.

A refreshing balance of juicy pear and citrus wiht a light creamy finish. We're about helping improve our environment, working with nature to put back more than we take out. Great wine doesn't have to cost the earth.

Inspired by their mighty character, 'Big Dog' is a range of wines that honour our larger canine companions. Sadie's Sauvignon Blanc reveals vibrant aromas of lime, passionfruit and apple. Guava, nettle and a hint of pineapple flavour give this wine length. Pairs well with goat's cheese.

Wine speaks to us, and we speak of wine. Lingo showcases alternative varieties in a fun, approachable and modern sense. Lingo demystifies difficult to pronounce wine varieties and invites us to embrace them with confidence.
We have Lingo so the words no longer trip over our tongue. This fiano has complex aromas of lemons, grapefruit with undertones of pears and almonds. A rich palate dominated with a citrus and floral flavours. A strong almond nutty character gives texture and weight. This persistent flavour balances the crisp refreshing acidity.
We explored the Adelaide Hills to craft this wine, much like the nearby magnificent MorialtaConservation park is best discovered through its many paths, track and trails.

Like the Paradox of life, an infinate mystery, this wine is like no other. Fresh, light, and irresistibly delicate, this pinot gris is lighter in alcohol and full of flavour. A zesty wine with hints of fresh lime & stonefruit, followed by crunchy green apple which leads to a light refreshing finish.

Like the Paradox of life, an infinate mystery, this wine is like no other. Fresh, light, and irresistibly delicate, this sauvignon blanc is lighter in alcohol and full of flavour. A crisp and refreshing wine with tropical fruit and citrus flavours followed by a long vibrant finish.

The critical late-summer/autumn ripening period was perfect for bringing out the best qualities from each our vineyards giving it Intense upfront full, rich and ripe fruits.
Food Matching: Chardonnay pairs brilliantly with the succulent fattiness of salmon. The crunchy skin of pan-seared salmon gives a lovely, contrasting texture to this
otherwise smooth, satin-textured pairing.

This is followed by Strong upfront flavours of white nectarines, with undertones of spices and balanced acidity.

This wine has great depth and fruit driven flavours up-front, with notes of lime and clementine coming to the fore. The wine displays length, showing regional minerality and finishes with a beautiful crisp Eden Valley acidity.
Food Matching: Delicious with an Asian-inspired seafood salad.
This wine was fermented then matured in older French oak barrels for 10 months. It is a light and crisp style with flavours of apple, pear and a hint of rose petal.

Delamotte was found in 1760 and is one of the five oldest Champagne houses. Based in the Grand Cru Village of Le Mesnil-sur-Oger in the Cote des Blancs, the house is reknowned for the delicacy and elegance of their cuvees.

A 100% Chardonnay from six select Grand Cru vineyards in the Cotes des Blancs: Le Mesnil-sur-Oger brings fine acidity, minerality, and saline characters; Avize brings balance and structure; Oger brings generosity and fruit expression; Cramant brings minerality and smoky complexity, Chouilly structure and length, and Oiry the texture, body, and roundness.

With six years of ageing on lees, this cuvee is characterised by its pure, direct, and intense flavours of citrus flavours, saline notes, and complex notes of freshly baked brioche. This Champagne will easily enhance a range of dishes, from oysters to beef tartare, and will comfortably age for another decade.

A 100% Chardonnay from Grand Cru vineyards in the Cotes des Blancs, this cuvee typically spends four to five years on its lees before disgorging. This helps contribute to its elegance and finesse, as well as its distinctive chalky flavour profile reminiscent of the soils of this unique part of Champagne.

Very classy aromas of crisp green apple, citrus peel, and notes of freshly baked bread, grilled nuts and white flowers. Delicately structured with a framework of crisp apple flavours, crunchy acidity, and a moreish, saline finish.
This is bright and fresh, showing granny smith apple, lemon peel, pear and floral aromas and flavours.Serve chilled.
A wine made against all odds.  A small batch production blended from Tumbarumba and Margaret River made by legendary winemaker Bryan Martin.

Not wholly made of Italian varieties, the Bianco regional blend comprises Fiano (58%), Trebbiano (39%) and a little bit of Riesling and Chardonnay acidity and body. While the varieties in the Rosso hail from the north and midwest, the varieties in the Bianco take coastal mideast (Trebbiano) and the south (Fiano) and the aromas and flavours are all Italian. The Fiano gives the wine its honey, spice and a mild tang of fresh pineapple while the Trebbiano offers a brush of savoury sage. Just don't allow this wine to get too cold and miss out on the detail in the wine.

Surrounded by Chablis vineyards on all sides, the family estate was founded in 1973 by Jean-Marc Brocard, who has since been joined by his son Julien. The estate spans almost 200 hectares, 66 of which are certified organic.
The Premier Cru Montmains vineyards are located on the left bank of the Serein, where the slopes convey mineral and floral characters to the wines.
Appearance: Yellow with green and silver glints
Nose: Aromas of white flowers including acacia and orange blossom
Palate: Tangy with sea salt and lemon notes. It is a balanced, precise and harmonious wine.

At Cigalus, to craft premium wines in the South of France, Gérard Bertrand has opted for organic methods, a system of living vine- growing which enhances the expression of the terroir and the unique characteristics of the grape varieties in the best plots of the estate. All the work in the vineyard – ploughing and pruning – and in the cellars is driven by a calendar based on two celestial objects: the moon and the sun.
The Indomptable de Cigalus Blanc, produced from a blend of chardonnay, viognier and sauvignon blanc, has a beautiful shiny and limpid golden yellow colour.
The intense and complex nose reveals notes of grapefruit, white peach, honey and dried fruit with toasty hints. The palate is full and silky, ripe, with notes of vanilla, butter and exotic fruits.

Distinguished by true to the varietal lemon, citrus, spice and tropical fruits, a delightful edge of minerality and crunchy fresh acidity, Tahbilk Marsanne can be enjoyed as a current vintage release or allowed to develop signature honeysuckle and marmalade characters if carefully cellared.

Patient COTTAT was a famous ‘Master Goldsmith’ in the mid 19th century in France. Born in Paris, he loved the Berry region, in the Centre of France. Anciennes Vignes is a Sauvignon Blanc wine from the prestigious Sancerre Appellation in the LoireValley.
Tasting notes - Golden green reflections. Nose : Complex and intense. Prevailing aromas of acacia blossoms with a muscat-like note of passion-fruit. Palate : Full and fat. Very well balanced. Aromas of lychee and a touch of honey.

Patient Cottat is named after a famous master goldsmith of the 19th century who loved the upper Loire region, the birth place of the Sauvgnon Blanc grape. Anciennes Vignes (old vines) is a tribute to long-standing local traditions associated with the grape.
Tasting notes: Intense, exotic aromas and subtle smoky (fume') notes capture attention. The palate is rich, filled with tropical fruit, refreshing acidity and the typical smoky note of the Pouilly Fume' appellation.

FAMILLE BOUGRIER has been working for 130 years for the recognition of Loire Valley wines and is recognized today as one of the last family houses covering the whole of the Loire Valley, from Nantes to Sancerre.
Produced from 100% Loire Valley-grown Chenin Blanc, this is a modern expression of the grape. Fresh aromas of citrus fruit with floral notes carry through to a ripe and fruity palate with notes of honey and stone fruit. Very well-balanced and elegant with a crisp dry finish. Serve with soft cheese and fresh salads.

A blend of 50% Schonburger and 50% Chardonnay Musque this naturally sparkling sulpher free wine is a whole lot of fun! $1 from each bottle goes to supporting the souther ocean carbon company! The first step in making a carbon positive brand!

Fresh with a pleasant acid cut and great equilibrium between fruit notes and mineral tones on the palate. Arvià in Piedmont dialect means "lively, ready," and can refer to a vivacious and smart kid.

A crisp fruit driven Chardonnay. Enticing aromas of peach, lemon and white flowers lead to a vibrant palate of stonefruit and pear with a hint of oak. Everythig you love about chardonnay with only 8% alcohol.

Drink now or reward with cellaring.

Its Pinot Gris is a stunning regional example of this classic French style delivering ripe pear and quince characters, a ripe fruity palate of fleshy weight and richness leaving and a fresh finish.
Grapes from Marlborough have produced a crisp Chardonnay with flavours of citrus, nectarine and pineapple and a lovely toasty finish.

Tread Softly is dedicated to reducing its carbon footprint and chooses sustainable vineyard management and winemaking techniques to ensure its production has a minimal impact on the environment. For every case of Tread Softly sold, the brand proudly commits to planting an Australian native tree – to date, that is over 1.5 million trees.

The Ethereal One celebrates wines with ethereal qualities ~ so delicious, delicate and graceful in style they seem not to be of this world. This vibrant Fleurieu Vermentino is brimming with light citrus blossom on the nose with fragrant hints of pear and stone fruits. There are fresh and lively flavours of zesty grapefruit leading to a silky, savoury and textural finish. .
T’Gallant Light & Fresh Pink Moscato is sweet and lighter in alcohol. A delicious lighter alternative for enjoyable moments with family & friends.

This refreshing Sauvignon Blanc exhibits typical passionfruit notes, with hints of wild thyme & Thai mint. Quite textural, with a lovely gooseberry acidity a citrus burst. Great in summer, or withyour favorite fish and chips.
A fresh and zippy wine with aromas of tropical fruit

This famous “signature” pinot grigio from Northern Italy's Alto Adige Region is a delicious crunchy style with pale straw colour, intense pear, honied apple, lemon curd aromas, generous pear, crunchy apple flavours and a refreshing crisp palate. The fruit is sourced from vineyards below the Italian Alps at elevations of around 300 to 450 metres above sea level on largely alluvial soils. The wine is cold vinified in stainless steel vats to promote aromatic freshness and pure fruit flavours. Organic land management (with accreditation soon) and other sustainable projects focussing on renewable energy, zero-carbon emissions and recycling are employed. Santa Margherita pioneered pinot grigio during the 1960s and established a world-wide reputation for its fresh fruity and minerally pinot grigio style. Intense varietal expression and linear freshness epitomise modernity and versatility. Santa Margherita Pinot Grigio can be enjoyed as an aperitif or with a meal of many types, especially antipasto, seafood, pasta, chicken, veal and cheeses. Vegan friendly wine.

Following clarification of the juice it was then inoculated with a cultured yeast strain and fermented at 15 degrees to retain the delicate Sauvignon blanc aromas. Sweet tropical fruit with floral musk aromas and hints of fresh citrus provide a refreshing spritzy finish.
Lifted stone fruit with subtle, toasty notes. Crisp with bright fruit characters. Fresh stone fruit with lemon citrus. Subtle toasty notes with creamy complexity and a zesty bright finish.

Notes: A youthful Assyrtiko, friendly and refreshing. A beautiful wine, with crisp acidity and intense fruity aromas – citrus and other, more tropical and more plethoric – comprise a character entirely different and lighter than that of the
Santorinian ancestors.
This premium Riesling is fresh with crisp apple and zesty citrus aromas. With complexity of flavour, balanced by natural acidity and a dry finish.

Hailing from South Australia’s famous Fleurieu Peninsula, this Vermentino features the aroma of nashi pear and lemon blossom, followed by generous lime, white peach and citrus fruit flavours on the palate. A delicious, balanced wine with a textural, persistent finish. Pairs well with vegetarian dishes.

A zippy Riesling with lively, refreshing acidity and a clean dry finish. Aromatic notes of zesty lemon citrus and pretty floral flavours on the palate and nose. This wine is the perfect start to any meal.

The Clare Valley is renowned for producing outstanding wines. Sourced from premium parcels of grapes from across the region, this fresh and elegant Riesling shows steely lime fruit character, fresh acidity and long length of flavour. This wine may be enjoyed now, or will reward with careful cellaring over the medium term.
Bottled Chaos provides an insight into what winemakers taste in the winery when tasting ferments and wines still in their raw state, the results are perfect in their characterful chaos.

This seductive Pinot Grigio comes from the beautiful undulating agrarian countryside of Puglia. Situated at the heal of Italy and skirted by the Adriatic and Mediterranean seas this romantic classical landscape of olive groves, market gardens and vineyards is dominated by vivid red soils and punctuated by hill towns, traditional whitewashed trulli houses, seaside fortresses and Roman ruins. The long hot dry summers and cool night breezes are ideal conditions for producing generously flavoured wines. Pinot Grigio is naturally high in acidity while cool fermentation techniques can preserve fruitiness and freshness. Notte Rossa Pinot Grigio is a ripe expression and offers lovely nectarine, white apricot, pear aromas, intense sweet fruit flavours, creamy textures and plenty of refreshing crisp acidity. It’s a lovely foil to the leaner minerally styles of Northern Italy and perfect for the Australian palate! Enjoy with antipasto of all types, chicken schnitzel, grilled fish, risotto or hard cheeses.

Bright pale straw. Harmonious fine fruit with savoury complexities, displaying perfumes of nashi pear, Granny Smith apples and nectarine skin with hints of lemon butter, herb salt, crushed shells and a hit of Chinese five spice. A seamless palate with acidity that is so soft, yet shows stunning freshness. Creamy yet vibrant. This is a cool year, that shows restraint and super-fine balance.

Studio by Miraval Vermentino is the latest release from the “Brangelina” stable. While Hollywood brings the “razzle-dazzle” reputation, Miraval is one of the world’s most authentic celebrity wine brands. Actor Brad Pitt once dreamed of becoming an architect and his enthusiasm for precision and aesthetic beauty – are encapsulated by this tremendously impactful vermentino. By partnering with the Perrin Family, he found kindred souls who could use their considerable experience to farm and vinify expressive wines that stood for something. Although Miraval is based in the ancient village of Correns in Provence its - Studio de Miraval - derives from more widely sourced fruit. This neatly reflects the story of the estate’s recording studio which has hosted many famous rock bands including Australia’s AC/DC and Pink Floyd. Vermentino (also known as Rolle) is prolifically grown amongst the pine trees and olive groves along the French Riviera. The warm growing conditions and proximity to the Mediterranean Sea allow these grapes to accumulate plenty of flavour and aromatic freshness. The wine is cool vinified to promote clarity and varietal definition. Battonage (lees-stirring) is practiced achieving roundness and texture. The Studio de Miraval Vermentino is a reference style with intense pear, lime, white apricot, tonic water aromas, ripe generous flavours, attractive mid-palate creaminess, attractive bitter-sweet notes and fine minerally acidity. This is a delicious summer wine that can be enjoyed on all occasions especially with friends over a meal. Pair with salmon, pork fennel sausages, roasted vegetables, tomato salads or soft and hard cheeses.

Le Lulu Sauvignon Blanc is a popular “Vin de France” featuring Liberty, Quality and Creativity! Meticulous sourcing and modern winemaking technologies result in a delicious fruit driven wine showing pure fruit aromatics and liveliness. The fruit is sourced from vineyards between the Pyrenees and the Atlantic coast including Gascony. The growing season benefits from a maritime influence and warm summers. Vinified in stainless steel the fruit-driven Lulu Le Francais Sauvignon Blanc style is all about fun, fruitiness and freshness. Tropical fruit, grapefruit aromas and flavours, plentiful sweet fruit notes and a persistent tang are typical. This is a very versatile and gluggable wine! Pair with antipasto, raw or grilled fish, Niçoise salad, or quiche. Or enjoy with friends.

Cotes du Roses Chardonnay is a classic ripe fruit-driven style that reflects the warm Mediterranean climate and the varied “terroirs” of the Languedoc region. The soils range from limestone and schist to river gravels and the vineyards are all managed with sustainable principles. The fruit is picked at optimum ripeness and cool-vinified in stainless steel. The unique bottle with its base shaped as a rose, offers another experience all together. When tipped into an ice bucket it looks like a sculpture of a rose, wrapped in glass. Cotes du Roses Chardonnay exemplifies Gerard Bertrand’s eye for design and craftsmanship and typifies the warm relaxed Mediterranean lifestyle. The wine is light gold in colour with intense grapefruit, apricot, tropical fruit aromas and flavours, supple textures, lovely mid-palate richness and plenty of mineral length. Chill it down as an aperitif and enjoy the romance - or share with friends over a meal. Pair with seafood, white meats or salads.

Le Sauvignon Blanc by Paul Mas is the quintessential South of France experience where warm dry growing seasons lead to perfectly ripe grapes and gorgeously seductive wines. Vigneron Jean Claude Mas has worked assiduously to build a vineyard empire using organic and sustainable practices. A disciple of precision winemaking practices he employs the latest in technology to preserve natural fruit characters and linear freshness. The sauvignon blanc grapes are picked at optimum ripeness and cool-vinified at Domaine Paul Mas, near Pezenas in the Languedoc. Typically, this vibrant and juicy wine is pale coloured with intense grapefruit, lime, herb garden, camomile aromas, lovely fresh grapefruit, tropical fruit, lemon curd flavours, fine lacy textures and superb cutting acidity. The silk screened “flower” bottle neatly captures and sells the floral aromatics and prettiness of the wine. This is very much a warmer climate style with plenty of expression, freshness and flavour. Enjoy as a sundowner or pair with summer salads, roast chicken or pork, or seafood dishes.

The Zonin family’s Castello del Poggio Delle Venezia Pinot Grigio draws fruit from sustainably grown vineyards in North-East Italy. It is typified by pure fresh green apple, pear, lemon glacé aromas and flavours, attractive minerally textures and crisp clean acidity. The Castello de Poggio brand is steeped in history going back to 1699 and the ancient fortress on the original property at Asti goes back to the 12th Century. After its acquisition in 1985 the Zonin family expanded the vineyards and extended the range to include wines from the Tre Venezie zone. This expansive landscape comprising the Veneto, Friuli-Venezia-Giuila and Trentino-Aldo-Adige wine regions broadly corresponds to the old Venetian Republic. High tech winemaking, “respect and care” for the environment and precision viticulture practices result in a signature light dry crunchy style with beautiful clarity and flavour intensity. It can be enjoyed as an aperitif or paired with salads, vegetarian dishes, white meats and seafood of all types.

Jean-Clause Mas has come up with a novel white wine with an eye catching spring-summer theme. With its elegant branding from top to toe, this original Pinot Grigio is a breath of fresh air showing plenty of enticing flavours. This wine offers an elegant nose of apricot with spring flower aromas. On the palate, it is a round, velvety and crisp wine, with great freshness and balance. It is the perfect partner for seafood, fish and sushi. You can also enjoy it on its own and an appetizer.

The Sacchetto family’s Mille Bolle Pinot Grigio is a light crisp white wine with attractive pear skin, white apricot, tonic water aromas, mouth filling pear, stone fruit flavours supple creamy textures and persistent refreshing acidity. Controlled cool fermentation in stainless steel fermenters results in superb definition and freshness. The pinot grigio (pinot gris) fruit is sourced from vineyards around the enormous Delle Venezie region of North-East Italy. The Sachetto family has been making wine since the 1920s and flourished in Italy’s postwar boom by producing fresh animated wines with plenty of flavour and definition. Next generation Paolo and Beatrice engage traditional vineyard techniques, modern technology and new outlooks to maintain their reputation as a leading producer. Their father Filiberto Sachetto says "Living in so much tradition is a challenge, but living it and showing it to the world is the foundation of our passion and work." The refreshing Mille Bolle Pinot Grigio Delle Venezie works well as an aperitif wine or enjoy with caprese salad, chicken or veal parmigiana, pan seared white fish or a hard Italian cheese like Reggiano or Parmesan.

Kendall Jackson Vintner’s Reserve Chardonnay is an enduring symbol of the chardonnay revolution and has a history going back nearly fifty years with the establishment of cool-climate vineyards on California’s Central Coast. The style has been refined over the years but the essence remains the same. The wine is typically richly flavoured and supple with fresh white peach/ nectarine grilled nut aromas, lovely mid-palate creaminess, underlying vanilla/ toasted hazelnut notes and long fresh integrated acidity. This Californian style is ample yet minerally with attractive fruit sweetness. Barrel ferment characters and French oak maturation give the wine an extra layer of complexity and fine lacy textures. This is a great retro-modern style that will appeal to drinkers who like volume, flavour, oak, freshness and balance! Pair with grilled fish or prawns, roast chicken, mushroom risotto or vegetable terrine.

The Grand Reserve Chardonnay is made from 100% estate sourced fruit from Santa Barbara, one of California's coolest grape growing regions. Perfectly integrated tropical fruits compliment floral notes, a hint of spice and vanilla as well as nice minerality from the calciferous soils in the Santa Maria and Los Alamos Valleys.

A wine with the pizzazz of a unicorn, but the serious expression of a rhino, it will charge the palate with a surprising blend of bright tropical fruits and zesty citrus. Dazzling not just to the eye but to every sense.

A wine with the pizzazz of a unicorn, but the serious expression of a rhino, it will charge the palate with a surprising blend of tropical fruit and pear. Dazzling not just to the eye but to every sense.

What superlatives haven't been heaped upon this legend of Australian wine industry? It has been at the forefront of this style in this country for so long that it needs its own silverware cupboard. Rich and unctuous, its like an avalanche of nectarine, apricot and marmalade.

Badiola is a winery in the heart of Rioja Alavesa. Founded in 2018 by acquiring an existing winery, Badiola offers village and single vineyard wines that display the freshness, elegance and depth of flavours which distinguish Rioja Alavesa. Made from high quality fruit from hilltop (“Cabezadas”) vineyards on limestone soils, this is an elegant, dry white wine with delicate aromas, which do not overpower food.

A wine of universal appeal, this Moscato is beautifully clean with a light straw colour and some youthful green tinges. The nose is lifted with aromas of musk, citrus and freshly crushed grapes. In the mouth the wine is alive with a vibrant and mouth filling sherbet flavour. The retained natural carbon dioxide from fermentation gives a mild frizzante effect resulting in a lively and fresh wine. Serve well chilled and enjoy while young and vibrant
Light and refreshing, this Sparkling Moscato from Piemonte bursts with peach flavours and a zesty citrus finish.

Planted on east facing slopes for optimal exposure to morning sunlight and Granitic soils resulting in highly concentrated fruit with excellent natural acidity. The concentration of the wine is lifted by the mouth-watering acidity bringing balance and long length. Flavours of Green apple, apricot, peach, hints of honey and floral aromas characterise a fresh nose.
A typical example of Grüner Veltliner, with aromas of green apples, citrus, flowers and white pepper leading to mineral notes on finish. Enjoy with white meat, fried fish or asian inspiried dishes.

This Sauvignon Blanc sourced from premium Australian regions has fresh aromas of passionfruit and lemon citrus and are displayed through the palate balanced by a crisps refreshing acidity on the finish.

From a winery that spans back 33 years, this range has been created specifically to be enjoyed with food. On the palate there are flavours of green apples and melon unfolding into layers of citrus and minerality. This wine is crisp and clean and will better suit fresh salads and grilled seafood while it's young.

The Gold Fizz is Moscato Giallo, aka Goldmuskateller - which is kind of cool. A lively little wine that’s just the right amount of tangy, sweet and refreshing. Think ginger, elderflower, honeysuckle. Impossible to stop at just one glass.

With fruit sourced from premiere growing regions along the North Coast (of California) expect a ripe and flavourful Chardonnay with aromas of baked apples, vanilla and buttered toast. On the palate, the flavours are generous with notes of crème brûlée, ripe pear and baking spices and a lush, creamy finish. Pair with creamy pasta or a roast chicken.

Our Earthgarden Organic Sauvignon Blanc has lifted aromas of citrus fruits, lime and grapefruit that leap from the glass. The flavours on the palate showcase fresh herbs, lemongrass and passionfruit. The intense fresh fruit concentration is balanced with zesty acidity and is perfectly thirst-quenching.

Rich, generous and approachable, the McGuigan Black Label range is your contemporary guide to Australia’s most popular wine varieties. Whether it be a refreshing Sauvignon Blanc, a full-bodied Chardonnay or Australia’s #1 selling bottled red wine, McGuigan Black Label Red, every bottle of McGuigan Black Label is packed full of varietal flavour, proving that you need not be a connoisseur to enjoy the wine of your choice for any occasion.

McGuigan was the first Winery to be crowned International Winemaker of the Year four times at the prestigious International Wine & Spirits Competition in London. Having now achieved the feat in 2009, 2011, 2012 and 2016, McGuigan Wines is recognised as a leading winery on the world stage.

This wine is made from 100% Albariño grapes from a sub region called Condado del Tea, which is loacted in Rías Baixas in Spain's West coast. It is a fresh and elegant wine with notes of citrus, pear, white fruit, tied together with complex minerality and a long finish. A versatile wine that can be drunk with anything from Sushi to Pasta.

This wine is a rich concentrated Pinot gris with lovely balance.

Floral and youthfully aromatic, the nose shows nashi pear, royal gala apple and hints of baking spice.

Fractionally off-dry to taste, the palate is textured and expressive, showing abundant fruits and spice. Long and lush with a lively acid line, the finish is moreish and mouthwatering.

Food Match : Roast Port or Thai Cuisine

This 2021 Clare Valley Riesling from Petaluma is both a youthful and young drinking wine but also has potential to be laid down for 5-10 years for exeptional drinking. The wine has a pale straw colour with a subtle green hue, citrus peel and sweet white fruits on the nose with lemon zest , jasmine and cherry blossom notes on the palate. the Acidity is fine and the wine is very well balanced. 
The 2021 vintage saw unusual conditions however these led to a very even and long ripening period for the grapes. the grapes were handpicked and chilled overnight before a light whole bunch press occured. the grapes underwent cool fermentation in stainless steel and bottled in spring of 2021.

From the West coast of Spain comes this fleshy, dry Albariño that displays ripe apricot and pear, and a lemon-lime vibrancy tied together with floral notes. Enjoy with anything from Seafood to a grilled cheese sandwich.

The vineyards of Monção e Melgaço are located in Portugal's north, close to the border of Spain and near the coastline. This fresh, fruity light bodied white wine displays flavours of peach and apricot with a lick of salt. Made to be drunk while young and fresh, Vinho Verde is best served chilled with accompanying seafood dishes and white meat.

An expressive blend combining perfectly the passionfruit and gooseberry fruit notes of Orange Sauvignon Blanc with the crisp lemonade and lime cordial of Hunter Valley Semillon. The palate is vibrant and lively with subtle nettle, guava and lemon flavour, well balanced acidity with a crisp, dry finish.
Intensely flavoured and very lifted Riesling character with citrus aromatics of grapefruit, lemon & lime. Enjoy as an aperitif or with seafood.

The St Andrews range from Taylors fly the flag for the iconic South Australian winery. The ultra premium wines are the true expression of the winemaking talents and terroir in which the fruit in grown. The Riesling has taken a little time to develop, but is now showing brilliant lime, citrus and tropical fruit balanced with cutting acidity.

A Riesling of great texture, personality and drinkability. There is a great volume of pot pourri, citrus & slate in the bouquet, providing a pretty intro to each sip. The palate shows off a really fine, powdery-chalky feel that is in harmony with lemon pith and green apple. The fruit sweetness and powdery tannins drive the long finish.
An elegant fragrant wine displaying floral spice and lime flavours. The fresh lingering acidity makes it a perfect match with seafood and Asian cuisine.

Under the winemaking direction of Michael Brajkovich, MW, the village label is the first tier in the Kumeu River portfolio. From vineyards around the Kumeu area, it is a wild yeast ferment Chardonnay with 100% whole bunch pressing and malo. One third is barrel fermented and the whole package seeks to highlight the white peach and flintiness that makes the area famous.

This variety made famous by the Loire Valley is starting to gain a footing in Australia.  Coriole Chenin Blanc is fresh and elegant on the palate, comprising pineapple and gooseberry fruits with an attractive smoky finish.

The 2019 Sauvignon Blanc was picked at optimum ripeness during the coolest period of the night to help retain the vibrant primary fruit flavours. It was transported directly to the winery post-harvest, crushed and pressed to tank and allowed to cold settle. 48 hours later the juice was cleanly racked and inoculated with yeast selected to best express Sauvignon Blanc's varietal character. The ferment temperature was kept at around 13-14 °C to retain the fresh primary fruit aromas while also developing a complex fermentation bouquet, and increased palate weight and texture. Post Ferment the wine was cold stabilised, filtered and bottled

Our winemakers have sourced parcels of wine from throughout Australia to deliver this Hidden Drop. A juicy and crisp Pinot Grigio with delectable notes of honeysuckle, pears & white peaches with an enjoyable finish.

Decrypting a wine takes skill and patience, lucky for you we've figured that out.
This Chardonnay displays aromas of fresh tropical fruit and creamy oak characters, which linger onto the palate leaving a long, pleasant finish.

Want a Sneak Preview? Then open the bottle and pour yourself a glass, you won’t be disappointed. This lively Chardonnay offers aromas of white peaches, tropical fruit flavours and hints of oak that develop onto the palate leaving a fresh finish.
Va Va Voom Semillon Sauvignon Blanc is crisp and light with fresh tropical fruit flavours that develop onto the palate leaving a clean finish. Perfect to enjoy on warm days with friends.

product_description: Make a difference! We believe in The Search and creating a lasting legacy that can be enjoyed by future generations. We produce sustainably grown wine from iconic vineyards, which means farmers minimise inputs in the vineyard and winery and only use organic treatments. We partner with sustainability organisations contributing at least 10% of our profits. Please visit our website to see how we are helping improve our environment and making a difference.

Brookland Valley is committed to producing exceptional wines by selecting fruit from premium vineyards within Western Australia. A softly-textured and full flavoured Chardonnay. Displaying nectarine, pink grapefruit and melon with subtle nut nuances. Beautifully balanced, the wine has soft acidity and a wonderful persistence of flavour.
A lovely blend - citrus blossom aromas and tropical fruits, with a crisp and zingy finish.

Released with bottle age this is a wine which will still continue to evolve over many years the toasty lemony flavours becoming richer and more intense. A classic benchmark Hunter Semillon, it has earned its place in the Langtons Classification of Australian Wine.

Harvest at optimum maturities from low-yielding, hand pruned and hand picked vines. The Morts Block Riesling exhibits intense flavours and aromas of lemons and limes, complemented by cleansing natural acidity. Grapefruit, peach, nectarine, estate grown Riesling of classic character.

Pet Mout Chardonnay is a Petillant Naturel from France made from 100% Chardonnay grapes. Following the "Methode Ancestrale" the wine is bottled before the primary fermentation is finished, delivering a lower pressure, lightly sparkling wine in the petillant style. The wine is then finished without the addition of secondary yeasts or sugar.
It is a lovely wine with fine bubbles, aromas of citrus fruits as well as floral and mineral notes.
Perfect as an aperitif or paired with poultry dishes, sea scallops or fish.
Devil's Corner Chardonnay shows some up-front ripe stone fruit, citrus characters and hint of subtle spiciness. It shows excellent flavour intensity with great persistence and a refreshing finish.

If you want to try the benchmark in this style then look no further than Pierro. A clean and concentrated palate of lemon sherbet and gooseberry with a hint of oak influence. LTC stands for 'little touch of Chardonnay' which adds the right amount of palate weight and complexity.
The vines for this classic, cool climate Riesling date back to the early 70's. Combined with high altitude and the granite soils, this is a wine of rare purity and depth of flavour.

From the ever impressive Yering Station, this Chardonnay offers toasty barrel ferment characters, good supporting oak and ripe peach aromas leading to a textured and well rounded palate. One of the better value examples out there.

Sourced from regions throughout Australia, Midnight Collective Pinot Grigio is light and fresh with lifted tropical fruit and pear aromas that follow onto the palate leaving a crisp refreshing finish.

Late harvest styles of dessert wine are more versatile because they remain lighter than their Botrytis brothers. The Bethany shows some delicious sweetness with a lovely tingle of Riesling fruit acid.

Established in 1985, Cloudy Bay was one of the first five wine makers to venture into Marlborough. Sauvignon Blanc is the iconic wine behind the Cloudy Bay tale. It defined New Zealand's wine and established the Marlborough wine region globally. It is the unmistakable aromas, ripe fruit flavours and fine structure that makes Cloudy Bay synonymous with premium Sauvignon Blanc globally. It is a fresh, aromatic & vibrant wine.
The flavour is intense, concentrated & focused with mouthwatering acidity that gives textural intrigue to the palate. It is a hallmark expression of Marlborough

Take the palate on the journey around the world, with the Azurial collection of wines, Explore Italy with this crisp and refreshing Pinot Grigio. Aromas of pear and organge blossom wth a fresh and vibrant palate.

Sourced from viticultural regions of Australia, The Painter Semillon Sauvignon Blanc is crisp and fresh with hints of passionfruit and tropical fruit flavours leaving a juicy finish.. Enjoy now paired with grilled fish.

Early morning harvest in cool conditions to maximize freshness and aromatics. Stainless steel ferment and maturation to encourage this also. The ferment is arrested by chilling the ferment when the balance of sugar and acid reaches its peak.

Another cracker from the guys at Remarkable State Wines. Fruit was selected from both cool and warm climates to provide both a full fruit palate as well as zesty freshness. There's a fine bead, refreshing citrus characters and a crisp fruit driven finish. Its a smaller batch brut cuvee that's really a great all rounder, enjoy on its own or compliment with a mixed platter.

Piquette is a naturally lower in alcohol fruit wine; sustainably crafted by upcycling pressed grape skins. Our Piquette from Sauvignon Blanc is light, crisp and refreshing, with vibrant gooseberry complemented by tropical and zesty citrus flavours. Ideal for those lighter occasions - lunchtime, weekday dinners.

1987-planted Chardonnay vines, hand-picked and whole-bunch pressed straight to French barriques (15% new), matured for 9 months, the majority without stirring. A citrus driven nose with white nectarine & oatmeal. Super tangy palate with a great balance of acidity & flavour; Almond, white peach, & lemon curd.

100% estate grown, single vineyard fruit grown on predominantly silty grey, gravelly loam over sandstone with some clay loam patches. 100% certified biodynamic grapes are picked by hand and then the fruit is sorted by hand on a vibrating table. Tasmania’s ultra cool climate is perfect for making Riesling wines with finesse and distinction. Winemaking at Stefano Lubiana takes full advantage of the perfectly balanced pristine fruit from the naturally cultivated vineyard. Minimal handling and whole
Adelaide Hills vineyards were selected to accentuate the citrus and melon notes in the wine to match the natural acid and tropical flavours. A well credentialled wine that bursts with flavour.

Pale green in colour, with a nose of snow pea and blossom a palate of lemongrass, rock melon, fennel seed, white currant and lime. This is truly ethereal and lifted but with a taut structural savouriness showing vibrant energy and exquisite purity. Pairs perfectly with Rock cod, scallops, prosciutto or soft goats cheese.

Sourced from low yielding old vines from the rocky, bony soils around the Renwick township in Marlborough blended with biodynamically grown hillside fruit from the acclaimed Churton Vineyard. Delicious palate brimming with nectarine, fresh lime, and hints of ripe nectarine and gooseberry finishing with a lovely long feel of the stony soils and refreshing acidity.

The Zephyr MK III Sauvignon Blanc is designed to disrupt the norm and stretch conventional thinking within the nuance of Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc. This wine is all about salted lime, unami, and mineral nuances.  An 'on the mark' match with blue cod, scallops, and prosciutto with soft goat's cheese.

Described as 'serious gear' for Chardonnay enthusiasts, Smith & Sheth hand select the best grapes from two exceptional Hawke's Bay vineyards to craft a wine full of character and almost Chablis-like that's as much style as substance.
Fresh and fruit driven, complex and light on its feet with vibrant acidity balanced by a creamy, lingering texture.
T’Gallant Light & Fresh Pinot Grigio is crisp and light in calories. A delicious lighter alternative for enjoyable moments with family & friends.

Farm Hand are Australia’s favourite Organic wines. Farmed by the Grigoriou family - fourth generation vignerons, from pristine 30 year old Organic vineyards located in the heart of South Australia. Farm Hand are proud partners of Carbon8, ensuring a great future for soil regeneration and sustainable agriculture

Located in the picturesque North Island of New Zealand, Te Mata produces a Chardonnay that has ripe stonefruit and citrus characters along with a rich and textural mouthfeel. Fermented in seasoned oak barrels to produce a creamy, rich and elegant wine.

Tread Softly is a contemporary range of wines that are naturally medium in weight and lower in alcohol. Tread Softly is dedicated to reducing its carbon footprint and chooses sustainable vineyard management and winemaking techniques to ensure its production has a minimal impact on the environment. For every case of Tread Softly sold, the brand proudly commits to planting an Australian native tree – to date, that is over 1.5 million trees.
