Produced from Gordo Blanco (otherwise known as Muscat of Alexandria) and Gewurtzraminer grapes grown on the Oatley family vineyards at Mudgee NSW, this is a typical lightly sparkling (or ‘spritzig’) wine that should be served young and fresh, well-chilled, as an aperitif or partner to fresh fruit desserts. Refreshingly spritzy, naturally effervescent, with lifted exotic aromas of rose, spicy pear and intense grape flavours, low alcohol and a hint of sweetness. Simply delicious, well chilled, with fruit salad – at any time of the day.
With the succulent aroma of fresh passionfruit and guava, our Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc is refined and delectable all the way to the full crisp citrus finish. Embrace the light.

Round Theory wines have been consciously crafted with a simple goal in mind - to make great wines that have a positive impact on the planet. Our vegan wines are sustainably grown and sourced, and our lightweight packaging reduces its environmental impact and we are climate positive and offset at least double the amount of carbon we use to ensure we not only taste good, but do good.

This Sauvignon Blanc is overflowing with tropical notes of guava and passionfruit, delivering crisp fresh flavours.

Round Theory wines have been consciously crafted with a simple goal in mind - to make great wines that have a positive impact on the planet. Our vegan wines are sustainably grown and sourced, and our lightweight packaging reduces its environmental impact and we are climate positive and offset at least double the amount of carbon we use to ensure we not only taste good, but do good. Notes of apple and pear shine through this Pinot Gris giving this wine a clean and lively palate.

Our Fiano is a modern Australian interpretation of this delicious Italian grape variety. Aromas of honeydew and white peach with hints of citrus blossom and kaffir lime. On the palate we taste an array of complex fruits from white peach and semi dried white nectarine, to white saffron pear and citrus with classic creamy texture that is Fiano. The wine finishes refreshingly dry and crisp. A great partner with salads, seafood, light poultry and a refreshing drink on its own.

The classic Margaret River blend. Pale green in colour, with aromas of succulent Sauvignon Blanc and grassy Semillon. The palate is flint-dry with an initial impact of sweet racy fruit and a fine and lengthy finish.

Some of the best Chardonnay in the country a sourced from the cool climate Adelaide Hills region. This crowd pleasing wine made by Ben Riggs shows classic stone fruit notes like peach and melon and these carry on through to the palate. It is bright and fresh with plenty of vitality.

The Serafino Sorrento Chardonnay is a crisp style of white wine, full of flavour and bustling with liveliness just like the Sorrento Township. This is the 1st release of the Serafino Sorrento Chardonnay, a wine that takes a modern twist with exciting new labelling and refreshing winemaking. Sorrento is one Italy’s most famous towns and one of Serafino (Steve) Maglieri’s favourite beaches. Perched on top of cliffs that separate the town from the busy marinas below, visitors to Sorrento enjoy the beach lifestyle, and a myriad of bustling bars around the colourful café-lined square. Food match: Fish and chips by the beach, Vegan Friendly.

Colour: Pale straw, lemon hues and green tinge.
Aromas: Orchard fruit, pears and apple blossom.
Palate: Full flavoured yet light bodied. A fine, dry, mineral palate with notes of white peach and citrus.

The palate is medium bodied with stone fruit and fresh citrus flavours and a light touch of French oak. Use of MLF on one parcel adds richness and roundness to the palate to ensure a more fruitful wine. The wine finishes smoothly with balanced acidity and lingering ripe fruit flavour.

Founded in 2001 Mr. Riggs wine co. is headed by iconic South Australian winemaker Ben Riggs, here we introduce Mr. Riggs first Sauvignon Blanc, Woodside.

The Adelaide Hills produces some of the best Sauvignon Blanc in Australia, the Woodside Sauvignon Blanc is no exception, crisp, bright and aromatic with tropical notes of passionfruit, melon and nashi pear.

To make this wine we stole grapes from our Hard Chard snatching them off the vine early to lock in their fresh crispness.A light bodied sparkling, clean and zesty style, with a crisp finish. A criminally easy wine to enjoy in many ways. Break out a bottle and celebrate with your gang!

Well, we made a cool wine, from one of the hottest and driest vintages, from one of Australia’s hottest wine regions. Pretty snazzy eh? Combine this with being dry grown, it gives us confidence our little region has a few more miles under the bonnet for the bumpy road of climate change ahead. 100% Chenin Blanc grown on Rocket’s Vineyard in Upper Swan. Soils are Houghton loam and the clones are Noack massale selection. The vines are planted at a density of 1540 vines per hectare. The grapes were picked on 16th and 22nd January 2020. Bottled on 11th November 2020 Alcohol 13%; RS 0.8g/L; pH 3.32; total Acidity 5.78g/L. The grapes were harvested by hand and whole bunch-pressed prior to natural fermentation. A portion was fermented and matured in seasoned French oak barriques for seven months prior to blending and bottling. The wine smells of lemon pith and nashi pear with a lick of carbide. The palate is lively with a briny spine, great clarity and stacks of flavour. – Rob and Gen Mann

A lovely off white, copper hue to the wine. Not quite rose, but a really appealing blush. The nose has mandarin peel, fennel and a touch of funk and wet earth. Palate is racy, with cumquat and dried flower notes. Finishes with a vanilla note, and a savoury, phenolic bite. There’s skinsy and bunchy notes throughout, but they are in harmony with the pristine fruit and energy of a white wine from this cool, humid year.

Native & Ancient explores the interaction between microbiology and human intervention, of man and nature, through a series of natural wines. The grapes for this wine are organically farmed Sauvignon Blanc sourced from Block 4 on the Isabel Estate Vineyard. The wine style, Pet Nat or Petillant Naturel translates to naturally sparkling and is achieved by bottling the wine while it is still fermenting. The wine is made in as natural a way as possible, harking back to ancient winemaking techniques, it is unfined and unfiltered with no added sulphites. A great way to kick off your weekend BBQ, refreshing, lightly sparkling, lots of ripe tropical fruit. A real fruit salad of flavours followed by a textural slightly biscuity finish. Delicious.

Inspired by style icons, starlets and celebrities, Dean & Monroe Icon Series features a show-stopping Moscato. A classic that represents the timeless glamour of Hollywood's elite and never goes out of style, this fresh and fun white is floral and perfumed with sweet, lush fruit and bright acidity.

Take a stroll through Franke's Garden...
Our Once & Well winemaker, Freya Hohnen, is often nicknamed 'Frankie' - and this collection explores the relationship between nature and witness grown by her hand.
With aromas of passionfruit, feijoa and lemon zest that flow into a palate of zingy lime sorbet and fresh nectarine. This is a fresh and lively wine, best enjoyed for those lazy afternoons in the sun's glow.

Luscious aromas of grapefruit and lemon zest with hints of orange blossom and green apple. Fresh and juicy with layers of citrus, white peach and ginger spice that cascades with rolling sea salt waves towards a textural, savoury and super fresh finish.

This fresh wine delivers plenty of lively fruit character and zippy acidity. It's a fan favorite for seafood, veggies, and small bites — a food-friendly crowd pleaser. This high-scoring wine delivers above its price point, a gem to share with family and friends.

product_name: Muscadet Sevre et Maine Sur Lie
product_description: The classic light dry white from near the mouth of the Loire river on the Atlantic coast of France.  The grapes are gently pressed and the young wine is allowed to sit on lees for 6 months to bring out that wonderful briney note fans of Muscadet so love.  It is bright, light yellow in color with green reflections. A fine and complex nose, expressive and aromatic. It develops notes of citrus, flowers and white-fleshed fruits. The attack is straightforward. The palate is elegant, mineral and aromatic. Citrus notes bring liveliness and freshness. The classic accompaniament is oysters, but just about any molluscs or crustaceans will do.

Crafted by the Calabria Family, Calabria BELENA, pays homage to the second generation; Bill & Lena, with a determined spirit, grace, and tenacity they worked harder through the tough times & prepare for the future generation - a true partnership.

Sweet aromas of honeyed apricot & citrus lemon that echo the palate to make this a refreshing Moscato.

The 2022 Springton Riesling is a blend of fruit picked from blocks 7,8 and 10. It is pale straw with banana and other tropical fruits on the nose. The palate is broad and subtly textural displaying stone fruits of nectarine and apricot with a long finish of lingering lime. An Eden Valley Riesling to drink now or lay down for years to come.

Precision, strength and freshness are words that form the signature of Brocard's winemaking philosophy. The domain is among the most important of Chablis. Brocard wines represent the higher end of expression at each level.
Their Chablis is 100% chardonnay, unoaked and fermented using natural yeast. Lemon, white peach and yellow fruit flavours, crisp and vibrant, pure and fresh make this a great match with grilled seafood.

This wine is made by the very skilled hands of Phil Lehmann. It shows as a pale gold with a green hue revealing cut peach and white pepper on the nose. There’s a lot going on once it hits the palate including citrus, grapefruit, nectarine and apricot. An elegant textural wine with a clean finish.

Lola Belle is the beautiful stranger who takes your breathaway. She's the essence of a sweet wine on a warm summer's eve, captured in a bottle. Full of exotic notes of guava and passionfruit, lightly spiced with musk and rose petal. Fragrant and fresh, with a zesty light fizz to finish.

Take a step back and unwind as time passes us turning seconds into minutes, minutes into hours; like sand trickle through an hourglass.
Deliciously light but filled with flavour at only 5% alcohol this wine exhibits aromas of crisp apple and pear, which lingers on the palate leaving a clean fresh finish.
The Hour Glass is perfect for long summer afternoons and the discovery of a fresh, light wine.

Ideally situated at the foot of the famous Roche de Solutré, in the hamlet of Pouilly, the Trouillet estate is currently run by William (4th generation).  The chardonnay fruit was hand-picked, gently pressed, then fermented in Burgundian oak to preserve freshness and finesse.  
The wine displays a fresh, open nose, the palate shows a good attack of vibrant flavour, with generosity and complexity important aspects of the signature.  Sourced from 50 year old vines, this wine exhibits all of the finesse expected of the grand white wines of Burgundy.

Ahoy-hoy! Alexander Graham Bell, the inventor of the humble telephone, demonstrated himself how the telephone worked to Queen Victoria in 1878.Queen Vic was just another Ordinary Monarch keeping on trend by learning a coming of age technology. Rediscover Moscato, fast becoming the 'it' drink for the new sassy Gen Z. This wine is the perfect introduction to this classic Italian light and delicate wine, it is fine and spritzy and pure joy on the palate.

Take a step back and unwind as time passes us turning seconds into minutes, minutes into hours; like sand trickle through an hourglass.
Deliciously light but filled with flavour at only 5% alcohol this wine exhibits aromas of florals and tropical fruit, which lingers on the palate leaving a crisp refreshing finish. The Hour Glass is perfect for long summer afternoons and the discovery of a fresh, light wine.

Latin for ‘lighten’, Allevio truly heroes the many simplicities of a great tasting wine. Vegan, gluten free, naturally lighter in alcohol and sustainably produced it has tropical fruit aromas and a soft minerality. It is perfect for complementing fresh salads rich with vegetables like artichokes, zucchini or green peas.

Savignin is the iconic white grape of the Côtes du Jura. The Domaine Rijckaert vineyards of Savagnin are located in Buvilly, a blessed terroir for great white wines. The blend was made with the aim of highlighting  the amazing complexity of this unique variety!  At once expressive, rich and refreshing. This rustic grape variety is both powerfull and fine, and when carefuly vinified, it expresses an unrivalled complexity.  2018 was a brilliant vintage, perfectly ripe, exceptionally balanced and with abundant energy.

From one of Languedoc's most energetic producers, Moulin de Gassac,  comes a crisp and vivacious picpoul de pinet.  A real crowd pleaser with floral aromatics, green melon and citrus flavours, finishing clean, brisk and zesty. One to get your taste buds going, and perfect with shellfish.

Intriguingly fragrant, with exotic aromas of crystallised Ginger, crushed Cardamom Pod, Quine and Allspice. The palate is bright and dry on entry, opening to pleasingly textural mid palate of Quince, freshly cut red apple and spiced pears before slowly fading to a clean, refreshing finish.

Velarino means "curtain" in Italian. Every theatre has one, and often it's a work of art. Opening the curtain can be likened to uncorking a bottle of  good wine. This is when the show begins! 
The Velarino Vermentino from Sicily will have you applauding as it entertains you with its fruity aromas and flavours of white peach, apricot and apple, not to mention the finale of crisp, delicious refreshment.
Take a bow, Velarino!

Barone Montalto is a crisp and delicious Sicilian pinot grigio, grown at 500 metres on the north-east facing slopes of the Belice Valley. This exotic example of Pinot Grigio has a straw to pale gold colour. On the nose, fresh and clean fruity notes of pear, green apple and white peaches. The palate is true to the nose with a fresh acidity, coriander and lime notes followed by a crisp finish. Drink with shellfish or risotto.

Produced in a truly Mediterranean climate on the south west corner of the beautiful island of Sardinia. From the esteemed house of Cantina Mesa comes a Vermentino of quality, vibrancy and intensity, singing of fruit blossom and a salad bowl of orchard fruit. A mediterranean herbal note, a touch of minerality and a refreshing hint of salinity add great complexity and refreshment. Finishing crisply, this would play an excellent supporting role to your next seafood meal.

Since 1858, Stonyfell has been synonymous with creating acclaimed Australian wines. Our celebrated winemakers continue the Stonyfell tradition and legacy with the 2020 Unwooded Chardonnay. Tropical fresh fruit aromas envelope the nose and lead to zesty, lively flavours on the palate. This unwooded Chardonnay shows beautiful length with fine acidity and a subtle creaminess.

Reserve Bin A Chardonnay has evolved into a wine that is now a distinctive, single-region style in its own right, with a contemporary and expressive Adelaide Hills chardonnay persona. Soaring and intense white peach fruits and defined natural acidity are well complimented by an interwoven nuttiness and heightened leesy texture. An expansive palate that grows, propelled by persistent flavours and textural integrity.
Peak drinking: Now - 2030

A crisp, stylish pinot grigio from the Della Venezie DOC in Veneto.  The wine shows straw yellow with copper reflections. Aromas of fresh apple and exotic fruit lead to pleasant and lively flavours, with clear fruity hints.  Excellent when served with fish-based hors d’oeuvres, shellfish, fried fish, soups, boiled meat and chicken.

Novum use small parcels of fruit from specially selected sites on established Marlborough vineyards to craft the best wines and expressions of terroir possible. Novum’s primary focus is on Syrah, Pinot Noir and Chardonnay.

Brookland Valley Margaret River Semillon Sauvignon Blanc is a great style to serve well chilled on a warm day. Lively aromas of lime, snow-pea and lemongrass are appealing and the palate brims with tropical fruit and citrus flavours.

Scotchmans Hills Chardonnay shows all the classical cool-climate melony varietal characters which are are perfectly integrated with light oak and restrained malo-lactic influence. Drinking beautifully now try it with rich seafood dishes.

This beautiful full-bodied round & rich with toasty flavours to savour & enjoy. This Chardonnay is silky & smooth, with rich notes of butter & toasty vanilla, and perfectly balanced with flavours of baked apple pie. Pair with creamy pasta carbonara or herb-roast chicken and vegetables.

Stylish bottle, stylish wine. The great Spanish house of Freixenet have extended their winemaking prowess into Italy. Their 150 years of experience are obvious in this elegant white wine made with the finest grapes from the picturesque Garda region in northern Italy.  This fine Pinot Grigio is packed full of fruity and floral flavours. You will also note subtle hints of citrus, making it a well-balanced wine, perfect to drink on it's own on a hot summer’s day.  Just as easily, you can pair this with a fresh salad or a platter of seafood.

Launched in 1998 with the 1995 vintage, Yattarna is the result of one of the most comprehensive, focused and highly publicised wine development projects ever conducted in Australia. The aspiration and independence of mind across generations of Penfolds winemakers inspired the ambition to create a white wine that would set the standard for ultra-fine Australian chardonnay. Selectively sourcing only the very best chardonnay fruit from cool-climate regions, coupled with clever winemaking, the style continues to evolve. Yattarna reflects Penfolds patience and continued commitment to its original goal, its very name being drawn from local indigenous language, meaning ‘little by little, gradually’. Each vintage provides the opportunity to further raise the quality bar.

Enjoy this premium quality Organic Sauvignon Blanc from Hawkes Bay, with a lemon tinted hue and fresh, vibrant aromas. Enjoy the burst of tropical fruit flavours, and a hint of lemon and lime zest on a crisp, mineral finish.

The Marlborough Sounds are a network of sea drowned valleys at the top of New Zealand’s South Island. This Organic Sauvignon Blanc is a pure expression of the pristine marine environment which inspires its name. Fresh floral and citrus aromas lead to swirls of tropical fruit flavours, balanced by crisp minerality and zesty acidity. Nature has crafted its finest work.

Like the Paradox of life, an infinite mystery, this wine is like no other. This Semillon Sauvignon Blanc is lighter in alcohol at only 8% and full of flavour. A crisp wine exhibiting fresh tropical fruits that develop onto the palate leaving a vibrant and zesty finish.

Like the Paradox of life, an infinite mystery, this wine is like no other. This Chardonnay is lighter in alcohol at only 8% and full of flavour. Displaying fresh peach and melon aromas, which are balanced with a hint of oak.

This Cote des Roses Sauvignon Blanc cuvée celebrates the Mediterranean Art of Living. The soil, very varied, consists essentially of hard limestone from the garrigues, schist soils but also gravels brought by the rivers and streams of Languedoc. The warm, windy climate (“semi-arid Mediterranean climate with mild winter variation”) favors the ripening of the grapes and their healthy condition, while retaining freshness thanks to the altitude and the effect of the sea, which mitigates high summer temperatures.
This cuvée boasts a lovely yellow colour with golden tints. It is fresh and intense on the nose, revealing aromas of citrus and exotic fruits, flowers, and a few notes of candy, pear, and pineapple. The fresh, flavorsome palate is lively, precise and pure thanks to the clear mineral backdrop and a certain opulence.
A perfectly balanced wine with elegance and concentration. Tropical fruits define the palate with complementary flavours of crème brulé, lemon pie, crisp pear and lemon blossom.

A sister wine to the riotously popular Lulu rosé. The wine is inspired by the ideals of relaxation, of holidays and fun. It's packed with floral and fruity aromas from the rapidly trending vermentino grape. Bright lemon in the glass, the palate is dry and refreshing and displays floral notes, fresh peach, citrus and green apple. The wine is rounded, with an ample acidity on the lingering finish. Chill a bottle, pour a glass, then relax.

product_name: Pietrariccia Surani Fiano Del Salento IGT
product_description: The vineyards that produce this delightful Fiano are located in Manduria, a region of Salento in Apulia, Southern Italy. An evocative wine showing straw yellow colours with gold hues, a warm, and an inviting nose with elegant hints of elder flowers and citrus fruit. It's medium-bodied with a well balanced acidity giving freshness on the palate. Perfectly suits fresh pasta dishes such as “spaghetti allo scoglio” or “linguine alle vongole” or with seafood and shellfish. .

Monte dei Cocci Fiano Minutolo is the result of traditional winemaking with a modern approach. The fruit is from the heart of Itria Valley in Puglia, grown at 450 metres.
The Fiano Minutolo grape is highly aromatic and the wine produced displays flavours and aromas of flowers and sweet herbs with fresh yellow fruit.
Highly enjoyable as an aperitive, and perfect with light dishes.

The wine displays a light yellow colour. The nose is fresh with notes of lemon, quince and creamy barrel fermentation characters. The palate is full-flavoured with spicy lemon and subtle oak characters. Fresh lively acidity balances the fullness of flavour and creates a long and lingering finish.

Vincent’s Breeze wines take their name from a picturesque stretch of water found between the Fleurieu and Yorke peninsula in South Australia known as the Gulf St Vincent. These wines were created by blending a number of separate vineyard parcels with the aim of balancing the strengths of each.
Honeydew and brown lime flavours intertwine with a smooth and creamy mid palate. Fine natural acidity give great length and balances the textural oak characters.

100% pinot gris grapes come from different areas located in the south of France: vineyards which are under Mediterranean influence and whose clay and limestone soils bring aromatic richness to the wine, and cooler vineyards in the Aude Valley whose grapes lend finesse and freshness.
A floral and fruity nose (lychee, vineyard peach, lemon and grapefruit) that meld with a touch of white pepper and ginger. Round and refreshing on the palate.

product_name: Orenji Project McLaren Vale White Blend
product_description:
A vibrant addition to the 'new wave' wine landscape that is right on point and a must try!
Super fresh and bursting with energy and zip, expect aromas of ginger, rose petals, orange zest and mandarin. The palate is equally bright and enjoyable with multiple layers of flavour along the same spectrum and supported by beautiful texture. Refreshing and difficult to resist.

Family owned Villa Maria Estate has been rated as New Zealand's Most Trusted Wine Brand in Reader's Digest poll 2016. This Sauvignon Blanc is sourced from premium sites in the Wairau and Awatere Valleys and it displays the zesty intense fruit qualities that makes Sauvignon Blanc so appealing.

The Yalumba Y Series Pinot Grigio is vegan friendly. The aromatics of the wine open with nashi pear, baked apple and orange blossom and finish with wild honey and feijoa. The palate is a succulent mix of the baked apple and feijoa with a fresh cream and poached pear mid palate, and a tight cinnamon and oatmeal finish. Lingering orange panna cotta completes the wine.
Jacob's Creek does it again with a Chardonnay with attractive melon and fresh fruit flavours complemented by subtle toasty oak that are all hallmarks of this fresh crisp variety.
This label offers classic Marlborough character at a terrific price. Aromas of passionfruit and gooseberry are followed by refreshing citrus and stone fruit flavours with a fresh, crisp finish.
This Australian dry white wine has fresh, tropical fruit aromas with hints of lemon and citrus. Delicate flavours of tropical and stone fruits leave a fresh clean finish on the palate.

With a history dating back to 1878, the Pike family has a past rich in brewing and winemaking. Current custodians, Neil & Andrew form a formidable partnership creating wines that express terroir magnificently. One of their icon wines, the 'Traditionale' Riesling manages to capture the essence of Clare Valley year after year.
This Pinot Grigio, sourced from premium Australian wine regions ,shows pears and citrus characters, balanced with good length and textual softness with a fresh, crisp finish.

Shaw & Smith is a benchmark Sauvignon Blanc. This release shows ripe tropical characters with restrained grassy notes and crisp dry acidity. Delightfully fresh lively and flavoursome. Always a classic and always quick to disappear off the shelves.
A delicate wine with dry, crisp fruit, supported by delicate acid. Perfect for parties, catering and cooking. Once opened it will last for months.

The Parson range is our invitation to discover the balance and purity we strive for in every bottle of Chapel Hill. Driven by an understanding that great wine is made in the vineyard, each wine is carefully crafted to highlight the delicious varietal characteristics of these extraordinary grape varieties. This is a drier Pinot Grigio with flavours of green pear and mandarin peel.

Introducing Whisper Rock, inspired by New Zealand's breathtaking and rocky landscapes. Embrace the magic of Whisper Rock, and let its whispered enchantment guide you on a wine experience like no other. This Sauvignon Blanc reveals tropical and grassy aromas with fresh fruit and citrus flavours. On the palate a crisp and zesty acidity.

Vavasour Sauvignon Blanc is a meticulously made wine with grapes selected for intensity and concentration. The bouquet shows passionfruit and white peach aromas and the palate has ripe fruit flavours with mineral notes. Always one of our favourites.
The Cat Amongst the Pigeons Chardonnay has a white peach, nectarine and melon fruit taste with a subtle oak, crisp acid line.

Since 1885, FAMILLE Bougrier masters the Art of Fine wines with the same passion and aim: offering the best expression of the French terroirs, and keeping the highest respect for land and people.  Renowned for the high quality of their wines, here they have produced an impressive chardonnay with characteristic yellow colour, with a nuance of  gold. Its subtle nose will remind of you some fresh butter, nuts and roasted almonds. Its palate is fully bodied and fruity with a pleasant roundness.

Discover the refreshing taste of Tempus Two Varietal Pinot Grigio, a light and fresh wine crafted in the Italian style. Bursting with fresh tropical and peach flavours, complemented by a hint of pear crunchiness, it's a crisp white wine that captures the essence of sunny vineyards.

Combining traditional style and vibrant acidity, this Pinot Grigio wine is perfect for warm days and pairs impeccably with delicate dishes. This light wine offers a versatile and enjoyable option for various occasions, making it an ideal dry white wine for cooking.

Uncover a world of flavour with Tempus Two wines.

Lean and beautifully balanced, this Chablis from Simonnet-Febvre has flavours of lemon, peach, river stones. Steely acidity cleans the palate nicely and is just so food-friendly, it is a must have for your best fish dishes. Quite easily one of the best value Chardonnays in the Dan Murphy's range!
With lively lifted aromas of tropical fruits and fruit tingle, this is a tight and crisp wine with fresh fruit sweetness and a touch of spritz, with a clean refreshing lingering finish.
Pale yellow with a green hue, this is a wine iof great length with aromas of grapefruit, peach, citrus, wet stone and flint with white fruit, citrus curd, and fine French oak flavours.

Riesling is the signature variety of the Clare Valley, and the 2022 vintage is considered one of the best for many, many years. Riesling of this calibre promises unparalleled refreshment when first released, then develops over time to reveal a rare complexity both in aromatics and exhilarating palate. This 2022 Riesling is undeniably an elite showcase of why the region is intrinsically associated with the most noble of white varieties.

This Chardonnay features aromatic expressions of stone fruit and apple, with a hint of herb and mineral characters. Medium bodied, flavours of honeysuckle and white nectarine support a creamy mouthfeel and lingering finish.

Chardonnay is all about balance, whether it be big robust flavours or tightly wound minerality - everything should exist together in balance.

While this Chardonnay is not for the faint hearted - it’s a full flavoured, buttery chardonnay, packed full of bold fully ripened stone and tropical fruit flavours, balanced by beautiful oak and delicate acidity.

Everything here is in balance, showcasing the full range of what Chardonnay can offer when it’s made well and with care.

Golden yellow straw colour, with yellow hue, the wine displays honeysuckle, stone fruit, apple blossom and spice on the nose with a palate loaded with plush clingstone peach, baked apple, and fig up front.

These primary characters merge with deeper notes of creamy cashew, oatmeal, pie crust and rich honey all entwined on a line of lemon acidity, culminating with a dry finish of tangerine pithy appeal.

Flavoursome and fine finish with crisp lines of cleansing acid. Excalibur Sauvignon Blanc is an exciting, fresh, food-friendly white wine. Although a great food wine, especially seafood, at Zonte’s Footstep, we drink most of the Excalibur well-chilled, on a sunny afternoon with friends and family... usually followed by a second glass!
A fresh and zesty Sauvignon Blanc, bursting with juicy ripe flavours of gooseberry, guava and lime. The mouthwatering finish leaves you wanting more.
This shows in the final wine with great depth of flavour throughout the palate with well balanced acidity leaving you wanting more.
A well balanced medium bodied Chardonnay showing bright stone fruit, rockmelon and butterscotch on the nose. Succulent fruit forward flavours and creamy texture lead on to a silky finish.

Concentrated and fine with a creamy texture. The vibrant
acidity provides excellent structure and balance to the creamy juicy
mid palate.
Honeydew and brown lime flavours intertwine with a smooth and creamy mid palate. Fine natural acidity give great length and balances the textural oak characters.
The palate has a soft, yet delicate structure with typical varietal flavours of nashi pear and lychee. The wine has a delightful creaminess but finishes dry with beautifully balanced acidity
This wine was fermented then matured in older French oak barrels for 10 months. It is a light and crisp style with flavours of apple, pear and a hint of rose petal.

This wine is a rich concentrated Pinot gris with lovely balance. Floral and youthfully aromatic, the nose shows nashi pear, royal gala apple and hints of baking spice. Fractionally off-dry to taste, the palate is textured and expressive, showing abundant fruits and spice. Long and lush with a lively acid line, the finish is moreish and mouthwatering.
Clean and bright aromas; fleeting touches of passionfruit lead into a palate with very good thrust, flavour and length before faltering slightly on the finish.

Produced by an iconic critically acclaimed winery, this modern styled Chardonnay is complex and elegant, richly weigted with layers of fruit, yet restrained by tight vanilla oak and a crisp finish.

This is a stuning, delicious Chardonnay that will last for a long time, but is drinking well now and is a perfect match for shellfish pasta.

Eden Valley rieslings tend to be a little more delicate and floral compared to the more zingy style founc in Clare Valley.

This Riesling is no exception - bursting with mandarin, lemon, lime lychee, white flower floral and fennel flavours making this Riesling an absolutely perfect accompaniment to shellfish and spicy Asian dishes.

Across the board, 2022 was a great year for Australian Riesling - and this one is a wonderful example of the sort of Riesling that Great SOuther produces - fragrant, pure lime juice flavours, zingy acidity, complex and fresh.

This is an exceptional wine that any Riesling fan will not want to miss out on.

This approachable, soft, delicate Riesling is a perfect example of Great Southern Riesling - fresh citrus flavours with a zingy acidity and delicate floral aromas.

It's concentrated and balanced, with good cellaring potential, but drinking perfectly with spicy thai food right now.

A thirst quenching delight, showcasing the Tasmanian cool climate and delivering great value.

This riesling not only has traditional lemon and lime flavours, but floral, textural notes giving it depth of flavour and aging potential.

A perfect wine to pair with Oysters.

Wow - this is quite simply a stunning Chardonnay and without a doubt the best we tasted during the year for the Under Wraps program - it has everything you’d want in a Chardonnay, a lovely acid line, flavours of citrus, stone fruit meshed hazelnut and nougat. THis is a magnificent example of Margaret River Chardonnay.

From the Pewsey Vale sub-region of Eden Valley,  this Single Vineyard Riesling if a clear and complex expression of the varietal.
Expect citrus peel and lime flavours, with lively acidity and soft minerality - an elegant and pure wine.

We left our cosy home to spread our wings and explore theworld. We were never afraid of running bare foot or swimming in the deep end why should we be afraid of Flying Wild? These wines inspire fabulous ideas and fabulous ideas inspired these wines. These easy drinking medium-bodied wines should always be enjoyed in good company. Bright pale straw with green flecks. Fresh flavours of lemon zest and passionfruit on the palate. This wine has a crisp and crunchy acidity and is ready to enjoy now.

product_name: Vine To Wine Nagambie Lakes Arinto 2021
product_description: Straw yellow in colour. Subtle aromas of lime and stone fruit, with complex secondary winemaking artifact notes of breoche. The palate is well balanced and is surprisingly full bodied with a round viscous mid-palate. There is a fine and complex texturered phenolic structure. The rich palate finishes with a green apple freshness. A complex and interesting wine.

The red berry notes develop intensity on the palate, with the wine being a lovely medium bodied rose. The structure is soft with a lovely fruit sweetness on an extended clean and crisp finish.

product_name: Gabriella Possum Ancestral Method Nagambie Riesling 2021
product_description: This wine has been fermented in this bottle and is therefore turbid in nature as it includes the yeast lees. The wine should be gently mixed prior to serving cold to homogenise these lees through the bottle. Complex aromas of tropical fruits, and the savoury brioche notes of yeast autolysis. The wine is very light in body, a fine mousse, and complex champagne like savoury flavours on the finish. This preservative free wine should be enjoyed youthful and fresh.

product_name: Vine To Wine Mornington Peninsula Sauvignon Blanc 2020
product_description: Pale straw in colour with a slight golden tinge. An enticing nose of yellow nectarine, guava, jasmine and pineapple rind are on show with subtle background aromatic oak influence. With time in the glass, the wine opens up to reveal fleshy flavours of yellow nectarine, guava and rambutan wrapped around a bright acid backbone. Concentrated and complex, the persistent finish leaves lingering notes of fresh orchard fruit and balanced savoury oak.

product_name: Vine To Wine Yarra Valley Chardonnay 2020
product_description: Pale straw in colour with green hues. Complex and enticing aromas of preserved citrus, white fleshed stone fruit, spice, fresh picked nuts and oak all leap from the glass. The palate has a depth and volume of fruit that builds in intensity as it travels across the mid-palate. The fine acid and textural elements of the barrel fermentation interweave with the fruit to balance and complete the wine.

The wine is pale straw in colour with a green tinge looking youthful and fresh, this wine shows classic Yarra Valley regional and varietal aromas of white peach, with subtle elegant French oak interweaved with subtle complex yeast notes. The palate is a sophisticated medium body Chardonnay being a true reflection of the cooler 2020 vintage. There is a fresh but delicate clean acid line, integrated with savour secondary winemaking attributes of oak and yeast autolysis. The wine has a clean extended finish.
Vibrant yellow hues with subtle rose and lime aromas. Crisp citrus and lime juice palate with a firm acid finish.
